paraphrase: Glorious Tilopa taught this to Nāropa on the bank of the Gaṅgā.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

paraphrase: Though mahāmudrā cannot be shown, you, Nāropa, wise and fortunate, who practise austerity, revere the guru and bear suffering, take this to heart.
speaker: Tilopa
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: dper na sa rlangs sprin ni nam mkhar dengs/ / gar yang song med gar yang gnas pa med/ / de bzhin sems las byung ba'i rtog tshogs kyang / / rang sems mthong bas rtog pa'i dba' rlabs dengs/ /

paraphrase: As vapour rising from the earth becomes clouds that dissolve in space, going nowhere and staying nowhere, so the host of thoughts arising from mind dissolve like waves when one's own mind is seen.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: dper na nam mkha' kha dog dbyibs las 'das/ / dkar nag dag gis gos med 'gyur ba med/ / de bzhin rang sems kha dog dbyibs las 'das/ / dge sdig dkar gnag chos kyis gos mi 'gyur/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: As space is beyond colour and shape and is not stained or changed by black and white, so one's own mind is beyond colour and shape and is not stained by the black and white dharmas of virtue and evil.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: dper na gsal dag nyi ma'i snying po de/ / bskal pa stong gi mun pas bsgribs mi nus/ / de bzhin rang sems snying po 'od gsal de/ / bskal pa'i 'khor bas bsgribs par mi nus so/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: As the clear essence of the sun cannot be obscured by the darkness of a thousand aeons, so the clear-light essence of one's own mind cannot be obscured by aeons of saṃsāra.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: dper na nam mkha' stong par rab brtags kyang / / nam mkha' la ni 'di 'dra brjod du med/ / de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal brjod gyur kyang / / brjod par 'di 'dra grub ces brtag gzhi med/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Though space is designated as empty, space itself cannot be described as 'this'; though one's own mind is called clear light, there is no basis for saying 'it is established as this'.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: dper na nam mkha' gang la gang gis brten/ / de bzhin rang sems phyag chen rten yul med/ / ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog / bcings pa glod gyur grol bar the tshom med/ / de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra/ / chos rnams ma lus de ru ma 'dus med/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: As space rests on nothing, one's own mind, mahāmudrā, has no support or object; relax and rest in the uncontrived natural state; when the bonds are loosened, liberation is beyond doubt; the nature of mind is like space, and all dharmas are included in it.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: lus kyi bya ba yo thong rnal mar zhog / ngag gi smra brjod ma mang brag ca 'dra/ / yid la mi sems la bzla'i chos la ltos/ / lus la snying po med pas smyug sdong 'dra/ / sems ni nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bsam yul 'das/ / de dang btang gzhag med par glod la zhog / sems la gtad so med na phyag chen yin/ / de la goms pas bla med byang chub 'thob/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Give up bodily activity and rest naturally; do not talk much — speech is like an echo; do not think — look at the dharma beyond thought; the body has no essence, like a bamboo stalk; mind, like the centre of space, is beyond thought; relax into that without letting go or holding; when mind has no aim, that is mahāmudrā; habituated to it, one attains unsurpassed awakening.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: dmigs pa'i yul med sems kyi rang bzhin gsal/ / bgrod pa'i lam med sangs rgyas lam sna zin/ / bsgom med goms pas bla med byang chub 'thob/ / gzung 'dzin kun 'das lta ba'i rgyal po yin/ / yengs pa med na bsgom pa'i rgyal po yin/ / bya brtsal med na spyod pa'i rgyal po yin/ / re dogs med na 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur/ / kun gzhi skye med bag chags sgrib g.yogs bral/ / mnyam rjes mi bya skye med snying por zhog /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: With no object to focus on, mind's nature is clear; with no path to travel, one reaches the beginning of buddhahood; beyond grasped and grasper is the king of views; without distraction, the king of meditations; without effort, the king of conduct; without hope and fear the fruit becomes manifest; the ground-of-all is unborn, free of the veils of latent tendencies; make no distinction between meditation and after-meditation, rest in the unborn essence.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: kye ho 'jig rten chos la legs ltos dang / / rtag mi thub ste rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra/ / rmi lam sgyu ma don la yod ma yin/ / des na skyo bskyed 'jig rten bya ba thong / /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Kye ho! Look well at worldly things: they cannot last, they are like dream and illusion; dream and illusion have no reality, so generate weariness and give up worldly activity.
speaker: Tilopa
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: las ni dang po gcong rong chu dang 'dra/ / bar du chu bo gang+gA dal bus 'bab/ / tha ma chu bran ma bu phrad pa 'dra/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: At first practice is like a torrent in a gorge, in the middle like the Gaṅgā flowing gently, at the end like a river meeting the ocean, mother and child.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: sngags su smra dang pha rol phyin pa dang / / 'dul ba'i sde snod la sogs chos rnams dang / / rang rang gzhung dang grub pa'i mtha' yis kyang / / 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong mi 'gyur/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Those who speak of mantra and pāramitā, the Vinaya piṭaka and the other teachings, each with their own scriptures and tenets, do not see clear-light mahāmudrā.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: yid la mi byed zhe 'dod kun dang bral/ / rang byung rang zhi chu yi dba' rlabs 'dra/ / zhe 'dod byung bas 'od gsal ma mthong bsgribs/ / rtogs pa bsrung sdom dam tshig don las nyams/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Not engaging the mind, free of all intent, self-arisen and self-pacified like waves of water; when intent arises, clear light is obscured and not seen; guarding vows with concepts, one falls from the meaning of the pledge.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: mi gnas mi dmigs don las mi 'da' na/ / dam pa nyams len mun pa'i sgron me yin/ / zhe 'dod kun bral mtha' la mi gnas na/ / sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong bar 'gyur/ / don 'dir gzhol na 'khor ba'i btson las thar/ / don 'dis mnyam gzhag ma lus sdig sgrib bsreg / bstan pa'i sgron me zhes su bshad pa yin/ / don 'dir mi mos skye bo blun po rnams/ / 'khor ba'i chu bos rtag tu khyer bar zad/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Not abiding, not objectifying, not departing from the meaning — this is the holy practice, a lamp in darkness; free of intent and not abiding in extremes, one sees all the dharmas of the piṭakas; one who is intent on this meaning is freed from the prison of saṃsāra; this meaning, in equipoise, burns all evil and obscuration and is called the lamp of the teaching; fools without faith in it are always carried off by the river of saṃsāra.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: ngan song sdug bsngal mi bzod snying re rje/ / sdug bsngal thar 'dod bla ma mkhas pa bsten/ / byin rlabs zhugs pas rang sems grol bar 'gyur/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Pity those in the unbearable suffering of the lower realms; those who wish to be free of suffering should rely on a skilled guru; when blessing enters, one's own mind is liberated.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

paraphrase: The song then states that by relying on karmamudrā the gnosis of bliss and emptiness arises, and that the blessing of union of means and wisdom, handled without attachment, gives rise to that gnosis.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: The stanza's technical instructions are not reproduced (restricted); summary only.

original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: (Its results:) long life without white hair, growing like the moon, radiant complexion, strength like a lion's; the common attainments are quickly gained and one approaches the supreme.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: 'khor g.yog chags sdang nye 'brel kun spongs la/ / gcig pu nags 'dab ri khrod dgon par bsgoms/ / bsgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis/ / thob med thob na phyag rgya chen po thob/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: Cut all ties of attachment and aversion to retinue and relatives; meditate alone in forests, mountain retreats and hermitages; abide in the state without meditation; if you attain non-attainment, you attain mahāmudrā.
speaker: Tilopa
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: 'khor ba'i chos 'dis don med chags sdang rgyu/ / byas chos snying po med pas don dam snying po ltos/ / blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi mthong / / byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rnyed/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: The dharmas of saṃsāra are meaningless, causes of attachment and aversion; compounded dharmas have no essence, so look at the ultimate essence; the dharmas of mind do not see the meaning beyond mind; the dharmas of action do not find the meaning of non-action.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: blo 'das byar med don de thob 'dod na/ / rang sems rtsad chod rig pa gcer bur zhog / rtog pa dri ma'i chu de dangs su chug / snang ba dgag sgrub mi bya rang sor zhog / spong len med na phyag rgya chen por grol/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: If you want to attain the meaning beyond mind and action, cut the root of your own mind and leave awareness naked; let the muddy water of concepts become clear; neither block nor affirm appearances, leave them in their place; without rejecting or accepting, one is liberated in mahāmudrā.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: dper na ljon shing yal ga lo 'dab rgyas/ / rtsa bcad yal ga lo 'dab khri 'bum skams/ / dper na bskal stong bsags pa'i mun pa yang / / sgron me gcig gis mun pa'i tshogs rnams sel/ / de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal skad cig gis/ / bskal par bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus sel/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: As when a tree's root is cut its branches and leaves wither, and as a single lamp clears the darkness gathered over a thousand aeons, so the clear light of one's own mind in a single instant clears all the evil and obscurations gathered over aeons.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: blo dman skye bo don la mi gnas na/ / rlung gi gnad bzung rig pa gcud la bor/ / lta stangs dang ni sems 'dzin du ma yis/ / rig pa dang la mi gnas bar du gcun/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: If people of lesser intellect cannot remain in the meaning, let them hold the key points of the wind and discipline awareness, and by many gazes and ways of holding the mind train until awareness abides in its state.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: Names wind practice for the less able; no method given in the song.

original.text: dper na nam mkha'i dkyil ni brtag byas na/ / mtha' dang dbus su 'dzin pa 'gag par 'gyur/ / de bzhin sems kyis sems la brtag byas na/ / rnam rtog tshor 'gag rtog med gnas gyur nas/ / bla med byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin mthong / /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2303, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 052_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཞི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: As when one examines the centre of space, the grasping at centre and edge ceases, so when mind examines mind, concepts and feelings cease; abiding without concepts, one sees the nature of unsurpassed bodhicitta.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
